# Burj Royale

> Burj Royale is a 58-storey residential tower in Downtown Dubai, rising almost 215 metres on one of the district's last remaining plots. It holds 215 one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments above a four-level podium, across roughly 55,800 square metres of built area. Residents overlook Burj Khalifa, the Dubai Fountain and the Opera District, with The Dubai Mall a short walk away. The tower was completed in 2022.

## Project Overview

- Category: Residential / Commercial
- Location: Downtown Dubai, UAE
- Status: Completed
- Year: 2022

## MENASCO Scope

Rising around 215 metres, Burj Royale is a high-rise residential tower developed by Emaar Properties on one of the last remaining plots in Downtown Dubai, offering one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments above a multi-level podium. MENASCO served as MEP contractor on the project, delivering the MEP works for the tower, which was completed in 2022.
